name: logos-marquee
title: Logos Marquee
blurb: Logos scroll horizontally with gradient fade on left and right sides.
description: A horizontal scrolling marquee of logos with gradient fade overlays on left and right edges. Uses the Marquee component with hardcoded logo data; serves as a template implementation.
use_when: Landing pages, testimonial sections, or showcases highlighting partner logos with scrolling effect.
avoid_when: When you need a reusable component with custom logo arrays; this is a hardcoded demo template.
a11y: Images have alt text from logo names; scrolling is continuous CSS animation without prefers-reduced-motion support.
